title: I Keep Getting Transported to a Resort Island Where I'm Hunted – A Reoccurring Lucid Dream
content: 🙏🥺 Thank you to everyone who has shared their experiences with the toilet rooms—I thought I was alone. Seeing others describe something eerily similar hit a nerve with me. I still don’t fully understand what this means or why it keeps happening, but here’s the layout of my reoccurring lucid dream that has played out over and over for years. --- The Setup: Getting to the Island Every dream starts the same way: 🚤 By Boat – Sometimes, I’m transported by boat, but I almost always jump out before reaching shore. 🌉 Dangerous Bridges – Other times, I have to drive over terrifyingly high, unstable bridges over the water. 🚗 High Above the Water – Lately, I’m being transported in a vehicle WAY above the ocean, which triggers my fear of heights and prevents me from flying away (yes, I know how to fly in dreams). Regardless of how I arrive, the destination is always the same: a tropical island designed to look like a Disney resort—but it’s not a vacation. --- The Rules of the Game The moment I arrive, I am forced to get naked. I don’t know why, but it happens every time. 🔹 I see other people lined up, but I never approach them. I don’t trust anyone. 🔹 I wait until someone approaches me with info, but they’re usually cryptic. 🔹 I know it’s a hunting game. We are being watched, tracked, and chased. Once set loose, the first priority is to find clothes. --- Survival Strategies (What I’ve Learned Over Multiple Dreams) 1️⃣ RUN INTO THE WOODS FIRST. 🏃‍♂️🌲 Staying away from people is the safest option. DO NOT go into crowds. The mall is the worst place to hide. 2️⃣ DO NOT GET CLOTHES AT THE MALL. 🏬🚫 It’s a trap. If you enter the mall, you are guaranteed to be found. 3️⃣ Walk into a random house & act like you live there. 🏠 This has been my most successful survival tactic. If someone is home, I gaslight them into thinking I belong there long enough to escape. 4️⃣ The Mansion is the End Goal. 🏰 If I make it to the mansion, I win (but I almost never get there). The problem is that getting caught = reset (meaning I get dumped into a different location and have to start over). --- DO NOT GO TO THE MOVIE THEATER. IT’S A TRAP. 🎥🚨 If I find myself inside a movie theater, get out immediately. But if escape isn’t possible… 🔹 DO NOT stay in the auditorium. 🔹 Go down. Always go down. --- The Toilet Rooms & Concrete Tunnels 🚽🔻 If I go the right way, I will eventually reach the toilet rooms—which lead to the concrete tunnels filled with pipes. This is the most dangerous part of the dream. Once in the tunnels, I have to rely on instinct. This is where getting caught is most likely. If I make it out, my next location is determined by my emotions: 🔹 Feeling determined = I reach the mansion. 🔹 Feeling anxious = I end up trapped in another house. --- Final Thoughts This dream keeps happening, and I have no idea why. It feels scripted, like I’m following the same pre-set game rules each time. But I’ve also learned how to manipulate the system and increase my survival odds. Has anyone else had something similar?? I need to know I’m not alone in this. 😳
